title: A detached test-launcher `live` run earns no host verification and shows no refusal line, so its pass is invisible to the tracker
outcome: A pinned `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs live …` run is either recorded by the host as a verification with its result, or refused with a visible credit line that names why, as the focused and full launcher modes are. It is never silently unrecorded.
acceptance: A detached test-launcher `live` run earns no host verification and shows no refusal line, so its pass is invisible to the tracker is done
